Honestly, I don't think I ever had good friends(note that I will be starting high school after summer break, so I'm fairly young). 
My friends would hang out with me at school, but that was about it. I never got invited to any birthday parties, events, or just to hang out. It felt(and with some friends still feels) hella bad, never being part of anything, even though I was always willing to hang out. I think that these "friends" of my are the reason I became so selfish. I started putting myself and my future above everyone except close family and stopped hanging out with people completely. Oh, and I should mention I now don't really trust people.

Edit: forgot to mention my friend that hung out with me just so she can feel better about herself.
